item.title: The "Everything" engineer: Why industry expectations are getting out of hand
item.description:
I’m a frequent user of Reddit. I find it fascinating some of the stories that I read, from AusCorp, where someone is complaining about having to do a white collar role for the next 40 years and being miserable. To a post on GardeningAustralia, asking if yukkas are a good idea to keep long term. Everyone has something to ask, something to share, and something to ponder.
